Maya (CSM): CoveHealth requested a hands-on enablement focused on embeddings quality and rollout guardrails. Theyre also signaling a renewal review in ~6 weeks. Can we lock a 90-120m workshop next week that includes a brief renewal check-in?
Leo (Enablement): Prefer a morning slot. I have Thu 10:00-12:00 PT blocked for deep labs. 90m + 30m follow-up office hours would be ideal.
Priya (SE): Thu 10am PT OK for me. We should run a 30-45m preflight with their infra contact to validate network access and example payloads.
Jonah (Renewals): I'll join the workshop for the renewal portion. Can we reserve the last 15-20m to go over contract concerns and adoption metrics?
Maya (CSM): Good call. I'll ask CoveHealth for: sample payloads, nightly data size, a point of contact for infra, and expected query volume by Friday EOD.
Priya (SE): Lab requirements: test API key with embeddings scope, sample CSV (<=10k rows preferred), and model pin. We recommend rwd-13b-int8 for embed tuning on their use-case.
Priya (SE): Posting a quick test curl they can run in their environment:
```
# validate embeddings key + model
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_EMBED_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-int8","input":"patient summary for triage"}'
```
Leo (Enablement): Draft agenda: 10m intros & success criteria, 25m data/metric review, 45m hands-on embed tuning + evaluation, 20m rollout + cost ops, 30m optional office hours next week.
Jonah (Renewals): For the renewal segment: I'll surface churn signals (latency spikes, cost per 1k tokens) and capture exec asks. Please add an adoption metrics slide (DAUs, call rates) beforehand.
Maya (CSM): CalendarBot can you create tentative event and include CoveHealth stakeholders + a follow-up office-hours placeholder?
CalendarBot: Tentative event created: "CoveHealth Embeddings Lab + Renewal Sync (tentative)" Thu 2026-04-02 10:00-12:00 PT. Addl slot: Office hours Thu 2026-04-09 10:00-10:30 PT. Invite link: https://cal.redwood.ai/event/xyz789.
Priya (SE): If CoveHealth cant provide payloads by Fri, plan B: run live demo on our sandbox with sanitized examples and schedule a post-lab sync to validate against their data.
Maya (CSM): Pinged CoveHealth. Also adding a short survey for post-session feedback so we can capture NPS + immediate blockers.
Leo (Enablement): I'll prepare a cost-optimization checklist: batching, cache TTLs, and quantization tradeoffs for embed models.
Jonah (Renewals): I'll prepare a 1-slide renewal risk summary and circulate it in the calendar invite.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all. If we get their infra contact, Priya and I will run preflight Wed morning. If not, we keep Thu as demo-first.
Priya (SE): Sounds good.
Leo (Enablement): :thumbsup:
CalendarBot: Reminder scheduled: preflight checklist due Wed 2026-04-01 09:00 PT.
Maya (CSM): I'll post the final agenda and feedback form here once CoveHealth confirms.
